description: jwt.verify(token, process.env.CALENDSO_ENCRYPTION_KEY || '') falls back to empty-string secret when env var is unset, allowing attackers to forge tokens signed with empty key.
jwt.verify called without algorithms option; library may accept any algorithm in JWT header enabling algorithm-confusion attacks (e.g., RS256 -> HS256 with public key).
CALENDSO_ENCRYPTION_KEY (an AES encryption key) is reused as HMAC secret for JWT signature verification - key-purpose confusion across crypto primitives.
Webhook HMAC uses SHA-1 (deprecated) while peer webhook handlers (btcpayserver, hitpay) use HMAC-SHA256. Inconsistent algorithm strength across webhook integrations.
HMAC signature compared with strict-inequality (!==) instead of crypto.timingSafeEqual; enables observable timing discrepancy attack to recover valid signatures byte-by-byte.

CALENDSO_ENCRYPTION_KEY used as HMAC key here, but also used for AES-256-CBC envelope crypto in packages/lib/crypto.ts and as JWT verify secret in 3+ other files. Single key reused across distinct pr…
checkWatchlistBlocking catches all errors and returns a blocked=false map for every email (fail-open). Service outage or induced DB error trivially bypasses watchlist enforcement.
OAuth refresh token expiry is set to 1 year (DateTime.now().plus({year:1})). RFC 6749 and OAuth2 best practice recommend short-lived refresh tokens (30-90 days) with rotation.
shouldEnforceCsp returns true ONLY for /auth/login and /login paths; every other page receives NO Content-Security-Policy header. Site-wide XSS protection effectively disabled.
NEXTAUTH_SECRET="RbyBOfiZFt/IsBL2E2Zy2idcKRH+WclnHEiu1FmRdf0=" committed as a real-looking base64 value (not placeholder), risking copy-paste reuse by developers.
JWT_SECRET="asjdijI1JIO12I3O89198jojioSAJDU" committed as real-looking string in .env.example, may be copy-pasted into production by developers following the example.
CALENDSO_ENCRYPTION_KEY="Lmqy57DlHKPvwwrtkwjL/8QtxJWxC/OV" committed as a real-looking 32-char base64 secret in .env.example, risking accidental production reuse.
CALCOM_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_ENCRYPTION_KEY="LDBFYLEVICRZBYQZUZCSTZRJFZUKZMEI" committed as a real-looking 32-char secret in .env.example template.
ARG NEXTAUTH_SECRET=secret defaults to literal 'secret'. Any docker build that doesn't override --build-arg NEXTAUTH_SECRET burns a known weak NextAuth secret into the produced image.
ARG CALENDSO_ENCRYPTION_KEY=secret defaults to literal 'secret'. Default-built images contain weak AES-256-CBC + JWT verification key, enabling forging tokens and decrypting credentials.
Dockerfile runner stage (FROM node:20 AS runner) has no USER directive; container runs as root by default. Any RCE compromises root inside the container.
apps/api/v2/Dockerfile uses node:20-alpine with no USER directive; NestJS API container runs as root. Privilege separation absent at container boundary.
jwt.verify(token, encryptionKey) called without algorithms option, accepting any alg from header. Same encryptionKey (CALENDSO_ENCRYPTION_KEY) is reused across crypto primitives elsewhere.
jwt.verify(refreshToken, secretKey) called without algorithms option; permits algorithm confusion in OAuth refresh-token validation flow.
Vercel webhook guard uses HMAC-SHA1 for signature verification, while peer webhook handlers (btcpayserver, hitpay) use HMAC-SHA256. Inconsistent and weaker algorithm choice.
CORS origin defaults to '*' wildcard in non-production when ALLOWED_ORIGINS is unset. Accidental NODE_ENV misconfiguration in prod exposes API to any cross-origin request.
Cloudflare Turnstile bot check is skipped if process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_IS_E2E is set. Accidental or malicious env injection bypasses bot/CAPTCHA enforcement.
validateCsrfToken uses !== string comparison for CSRF token validation; should use crypto.timingSafeEqual to prevent timing-based token recovery.
symmetricEncrypt uses 'aes256' (AES-256-CBC) without HMAC/authenticated tag. Encrypted blobs lack integrity check, enabling chosen-ciphertext attacks against decrypted plaintext.
randomString uses Math.random() (non-cryptographic PRNG) to generate alphanumeric strings. Used in NextAuth username-slug generation; not catastrophic but should use crypto.randomBytes.
POSTGRES_USER=unicorn_user / POSTGRES_PASSWORD=magical_password hardcoded in docker-compose.yml. If deployed without overriding env, production DB has trivially-guessable credentials.
app.use(helmet()) uses default Helmet config; no explicit CSP, HSTS max-age, or referrer-policy overrides. Defaults are reasonable but lack documented justification or test coverage.
CORS preflight maxAge=86400 (24 hours) caches CORS decisions on the client; combined with mutable ALLOWED_ORIGINS makes origin changes slow to take effect.
BoxyHQ SAML Jackson handles arbitrary metadata URLs for IdP configuration; without strict URL allowlist on dynamic metadata refresh, server may issue SSRF to attacker-chosen URLs.
npmAuditIgnoreAdvisories suppresses advisory 1113407 (fast-xml-parser via @aws-sdk/core via @boxyhq/saml-jackson). Documented as accepted risk; revisit when upstream releases new @aws-sdk version.
